name: Ciudad Juárez

queries.query: Ciudad Juárez mapa predios catastro GIS IMIP servicio de polígonos consulta pública
queries.scope: Find the city’s official parcel layer and anonymous complete geometry/API route.
queries.result: The official IMIP SIGEM confirms city cartography updated at parcel detail and links interactive municipal maps. Its ArcGIS REST directory is public; CartografiaBase FeatureServer layer 3 is Predios, described as “Predios digital, Cd Juárez, Chih,” polygon geometry in EPSG:32613. The queued WUP point returned one full polygon with only OBJECTID and clavetxt requested.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

queries.query: Ciudad Juarez official cadastral parcel map GIS public feature service polygons
queries.scope: Cross-check city ownership and public record schema at the queued WUP point.
queries.result: The official city-linked ArcGIS service supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF queries. Full polygon geometry and a stable municipal cadastral text key were retrieved at the WUP point. No owner, address, or personal fields were requested.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

portals.name: SIGEM / IMIP municipal map services
portals.operator: Instituto Municipal de Investigación y Planeación (IMIP), Municipio de Juárez
portals.observation: Official IMIP describes municipal maps and a cartographic base maintained to parcel detail. Its linked public ArcGIS directory exposes the municipal Predios polygon layer. The separate predial lookup was not queried.

requests.observation: Public ArcGIS Server 11.5 service directory lists CartografiaBase FeatureServer and MapServer.
Map service lists layer 3 Predios with polygon geometry.

Layer metadata identifies Predios digital, Cd Juárez, Chih; polygon; EPSG:32613; full extent includes city; query formats JSON/GeoJSON/PBF; pagination supported. Only safe ID field clavetxt and transport OBJECTID were requested in feature queries.
Full un-clipped polygon at WUP point; returned stable clavetxt 1-184-075-010. No owner/address attributes requested.

verifiedParcelResponse.locationBasis: The exact queued WUP point [31.6633818209033,-106.421992448914] returned this polygon.
verifiedParcelResponse.attributePolicy: Only OBJECTID, GlobalID and clavetxt; no owner/address/tax attributes.
verifiedParcelResponse.identityBasis: Publisher GlobalID; earlier cadastral label is retained as a display label.

source.name: IMIP CartografiaBase Predios digital
source.operator: Instituto Municipal de Investigación y Planeación (IMIP), Municipio de Juárez
source.coordinateReferenceSystem: EPSG:32613; full geometry queries returned EPSG:4326 GeoJSON
source.scope: 203 valid, distinct IMIP municipal Predios geometries verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Ciudad Juárez WUP locator, which lies in a returned full polygon. GlobalID is the publisher-declared per-feature identity; OBJECTID is transport identity, and clavetxt remains only a label. The earlier clavetxt-based full-grid exact read matched 23,424 source rows because the label 0 is repeated, so that descriptor is rejected without filtering out such rows. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging of 31 source features over eleven geometry pages, all 203 fresh GlobalID reads, valid synthetic UUID absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32613 found all 203 valid, nonduplicate and no sampled positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. A malformed non-UUID absence probe correctly returned HTTP 400 and is preserved separately. All source shapes and labels remain unchanged. Citywide completeness, GlobalID continuity after publisher replacement, survey accuracy and legal-title semantics remain unverified.
source.identityBasis: Publisher-declared GlobalID; non-unique clavetxt only labels. OBJECTID transports complete manifests.
